# AMOS program fixture

`Xerxes' Revenge.AMOS` is an AMOS Basic demo program created by Peter J.
Hickman and shipped with AMOS. It contains a 6,264-byte tokenised listing and
an `AmBs` appendix with four banks: one 28-image sprite bank, two `Datas`
banks, and one `Pac.Pic.` bank.

The fixture proves AMOS Basic header recognition, the listing-length boundary,
mandatory bank-set appendix parsing, and access to supported and opaque bank
resources from within a program container. Its third-party attribution is
also recorded in the repository's [`THIRD_PARTY.md`](../../../THIRD_PARTY.md).
